messages:
maria_pr: Quick heads-up — EU analyst briefing added for Thu 10:00 BST (calendar invite sent). Need fast quote sign-off and an embargo tweak. Can PR extend embargo to 10:00 PT for US press window? Also one analyst asked for a 1-pager pre-read.

ben_g: Who's on the attendee list? want to confirm analyst tier and any embargo restrictions (paywall/partner-only)? :thinking_face:

maria_pr: Attendees: Forrester rep, two independent analysts (EU-focused), and one APAC coverage analyst joining remotely. No paywall restrictions, but Forrester asked for 48h heads-up on embargo changes.

alex_m: I can draft the 1-pager pre-read. Do we have final numbers for latency/cost to include from the benchmark? Need them by EOD.

maria_pr: Putting the latest benchmark stats here — pull from the benchmark doc and use the small-blurb below in the pre-read. Please keep the language tight.

maria_pr: ```
Key highlight: Redwood Inference reduces median p50 latency by ~35% vs baseline model at 2k seq, and unit token cost down 18% with caching + q4 quant profile. Tested on A100 and H100 configs.
```

ben_g: tiny nit — can we avoid raw percentages w/o context? maybe add absolute ms numbers for p50 and p95.

maria_pr: Good call. Alex, include p50=72ms (2k seq on H100), p95=220ms.

press-bot: Scheduled: "Analyst Briefing - EU" Thu 10:00 BST. Calendar invites sent to participants. Reminder set for 1 hour prior.

joe_ceo: Quick quote draft (1st pass) — feel free to edit for press tone: "Our mission is to make high-performance LLM inference predictable and affordable at scale; these benchmark gains show the practical economics teams can rely on in production."

maria_pr: Thanks Joe — I'll shorten for the press release and prepare two variants (short + full). Need executive sign-off on the short variant by 4pm PT today.

emily_sales: I'll own inbound routing for briefs and analyst follow-ups. Can someone drop a 1-paragraph briefing we can paste into SDR outreach? Also, please flag any embargoed materials so we don't share prematurely.

alex_m: Draft 1-paragraph for SDRs: "Redwood Inference helps engineering teams reduce inference latency and cost through a production-grade serving runtime and intelligent routing. We're hosting a briefing with analysts to share benchmark methodology and deployment stories — would you like a summary?"

sam_ops: For the embargo change: Forrester wants 48h notice on any embargo shift. If we move US embargo to 10am PT, that still respects 48h for current invites? double-check calendar send times.

maria_pr: I verified — invites were sent 72h ago, so extending US embargo to 10am PT is fine. We'll note Forrester constraint in the PR checklist.

ben_g: Fact-check doc link (please comment inline): https://docs.google.com/document/d/1-fake-factcheck-link

alex_m: Pasted a few suggested talking points into the fact-check doc (section: analyst pre-read). Also added the p50/p95 numbers and the one-paragraph SDR blurb.

joe_ceo: Small edit to quote: change "predictable and affordable" -> "predictable, affordable, and reliable". :+1:

maria_pr: Updated short quote for sign-off: "Redwood Inference makes high-performance LLM inference predictable, affordable, and reliable at scale." Please confirm by 4pm PT.

emily_sales: Confirmed — SDR kit ready once quote locks. I'll also wire the press contact template and routing rules into the leads doc.

ben_g: I approve the quote. +1 from me. :thumbsup:

alex_m: Approved from me too.

sam_ops: Ops ok with embargo timing.

maria_pr: Great — locking quote. Final checklist: 1) Lock quote (done) 2) Upload pre-read to the invite (alex) 3) Send updated embargo notice to press list at 10am PT (maria) 4) Sales routing live (emily). I'll bump if anything slips. Thanks all. :raised_hands:
